title: Tech Note: Accepting / Verifying Payment Information

historical_commentary.text: 4D Business Kit has been discontinued, and payment processing has since been transformed by mature PCI-DSS compliance standards and hosted payment gateway APIs (e.g., Stripe, PayPal) that did not exist in their modern form in 2002, making the specific payment-handling techniques in this note obsolete and, in fact, likely non-compliant with modern payment security requirements.
related_updates: Modern e-commerce payment processing now relies on PCI-DSS-compliant hosted gateways (e.g., Stripe, PayPal) rather than the direct payment-handling approach implied by this 2002 note
